name: Settlement Transaction Type 7 Code
definition: Specifies underlying information regarding the type of settlement transaction.

BSBK.name: Buy Sell Back
BSBK.definition: Relates to a buy sell back transaction.

COLI.name: Collateral In
COLI.definition: Relates to a collateral transaction, from the point of view of the collateral taker or its agent.

COLO.name: Collateral Out
COLO.definition: Relates to a collateral transaction, from the point of view of the collateral giver or its agent.

CONV.name: Depository Receipt Conversion
CONV.definition: Relates to a depository receipt conversion.

INSP.name: Move Of Stock
INSP.definition: Relates to a movement of shares into or out of a pooled account.

ISSU.name: Issuance
ISSU.definition: Relates to the issuance of a security such as an equity or a depositary receipt.

MKDW.name: Mark Down
MKDW.definition: Relates to the decrease of positions held by an International Central Securities Depository (ICSD) at the common depository due to custody operations (repurchase, pre-release, proceed of corp. event realigned).

MKUP.name: Mark Up
MKUP.definition: Relates to the increase of positions held by an International Central Securities Depository (ICSD) at the common depository due to custody operations (repurchase, pre-release, proceed of corporate event realigned).

NETT.name: Netting
NETT.definition: Relates to the netting of settlement instructions.

NSYN.name: Non Syndicated
NSYN.definition: Relates to the issue of medium and short term paper (CP, CD, MTN, notes.) under a program and without syndication arrangement.

OWNE.name: External Account Transfer
OWNE.definition: Relates to an account transfer involving more than one instructing party (messages sender) and/or account servicer (messages receiver).

OWNI.name: Internal Account Transfer
OWNI.definition: Relates to an account transfer involving one instructing party (messages sender) at one account servicer (messages receiver).

PAIR.name: Pair Off
PAIR.definition: Relates to a pair-off: the transaction is paired off and netted against one or more previous transactions.

PLAC.name: Placement
PLAC.definition: Relates to the placement/new issue of a financial instrument.

PORT.name: Portfolio Move
PORT.definition: Relates to a portfolio move from one investment manager to another and/or from an account servicer to another. It is generally charged differently than another account transfer, hence the need to identify this type of transfer as such.

REAL.name: Realignment
REAL.definition: Relates to a realignment of positions.

REDI.name: Withdrawal
REDI.definition: Relates to the withdrawal of specified amounts from specified subaccounts.

RELE.name: Depository Receipt Release Cancellation
RELE.definition: Relates to a release (into/from local) of depository receipt operation.

REPU.name: Repo
REPU.definition: Relates to a repurchase agreement transaction.

RODE.name: Return Delivery Without Matching
RODE.definition: Relates to the return of financial instruments resulting from a rejected delivery without matching operation.

RPTO.name: Reporting
RPTO.definition: Relates to a transaction that is for reporting purposes only.

RVPO.name: Reverse Repurchase Agreement
RVPO.definition: Relates to a reverse repurchase agreement transaction.

SBBK.name: Sell Buy Back
SBBK.definition: Relates to a sell buy back transaction.

SECB.name: Securities Borrowing
SECB.definition: Relates to a securities borrowing operation.

SECL.name: Securities Lending
SECL.definition: Relates to a securities lending operation.

SYND.name: Syndicate Underwriters
SYND.definition: Relates to the issue of financial instruments through a syndicate of underwriters and a lead manager.

TBAC.name: TBA Closing
TBAC.definition: Relates to a To Be Announced (TBA) closing trade.

TRAD.name: Trade
TRAD.definition: Relates to the settlement of a trade.

TRPO.name: Triparty Repo
TRPO.definition: Relates to a triparty repurchase agreement.

TRVO.name: Triparty Reverse Repo
TRVO.definition: Relates to a triparty reverse repurchase agreement.

TURN.name: Turnaround
TURN.definition: Relates to a turnaround: the same security is bought and sold to settle the same day, to or from different brokers.

GUAR.name: Guaranteed Close
GUAR.definition: Trade which is guaranteed to be finalized.
